deployment.note: No endpoint or credentials are supplied by this draft. Do not interpret saved weights, UI draft configuration, or the unavailable example as a successful tool call.

tool_definition.name: screen_fundus
tool_definition.description: Call the real versioned four-expert fundus screening backend and return evidence plus stage execution status. With no connected backend, return tool_unavailable; never synthesize model outputs.

image_url.description: Accessible HTTPS fundus image resource. The backend validates/decodes it; the agent must not replace it with invented content.

shared_input_contract.decode: Decode source image once to RGB, then apply each expert's own saved deterministic preprocessing independently.
shared_input_contract.image_fetch_validation: The backend must validate permitted resource locations, redirect destinations, file size/type and decoded dimensions; the language model does not fetch arbitrary internal resources.
shared_input_contract.log_policy: Use request/image fingerprints for traceability; do not expose credentials, local paths or signed URL secrets in user-facing output.

semantics.OPTIC_DISC_CUPPING: Optic-disc cupping phenotype; not a glaucoma diagnosis.
semantics.ABNORMAL: Independent abnormality label; do not derive by OR/max of the other four outputs.
semantics.scores: Five independent model scores; they do not sum to one and are not validated individual disease probabilities.

dr_grading.initialization_note: Weights-only initialization from the APTOS head-only epoch5 checkpoint, followed by DDR training; not a raw pretrained zero-shot classifier.

preprocessing.resize: Aspect-preserving PIL_BILINEAR with centered black padding; use the shared saved implementation, not a hand-written approximate crop.

disc_cup_segmentation.source_provenance: Previously audited mixed incomplete REFUGE/REFUGE2 public mirror and unchanged source-isolated manifests; not asserted to be a pure official REFUGE release.
disc_cup_segmentation.semantics: Segmentation is not a glaucoma classifier; measurements require real mask computation and explicit coordinate space.

routing_policy.quality_reject_behavior: Stop downstream inference; mark remaining stages not_run with reason quality_rejected and output null. Return quality_rejected, advise image retake/manual review, never a negative disease result.
routing_policy.quality_usable_behavior: Retain the quality warning; do not relabel Usable as Good.
routing_policy.note: Candidate 0.3 gates must not be presented as validated/calibrated production thresholds. Historical classifier evaluation at 0.5 does not measure gate recall at 0.3. Do not silently activate candidate gates; runtime must return the explicit configured policy and its validation state.

routing.description: Actual policy ID, validation state, actual thresholds and per-stage trigger reasons; null if not executed/unconfigured.

quality.scores: Object with exactly Good/Usable/Reject finite numeric keys in [0,1]; sum approximately 1.
quality.predicted_label: One of Good/Usable/Reject, consistent with argmax.
quality.calibration_state: Explicit unvalidated or actual versioned validation calibration reference.

multidisease.scores: Object with exactly the five finite sigmoid scores in [0,1]. Do not normalize their sum.
multidisease.decision_thresholds: Actual per-label thresholds returned by the backend, or null if no binary decision policy is configured.
multidisease.binary_decisions: Backend-computed per-label booleans from an actual configured decision policy, or null; the language model must not invent or silently recompute decisions.
multidisease.calibration_state: Explicit unvalidated or actual versioned validation calibration reference.

dr_grading.scores: Five finite softmax scores in fixed grade order, each in [0,1], sum approximately 1.
dr_grading.predicted_grade: Integer 0..4 from argmax; only present for a completed real DR inference.
dr_grading.calibration_state: Explicit unvalidated or actual versioned validation calibration reference.

disc_cup_segmentation.mask_artifacts: Actual backend-created cup/disc mask references and optional overlay; null references cannot be replaced by invented URLs.
disc_cup_segmentation.mask_threshold: Actual threshold, initially historical 0.5; any change requires a separately versioned validation policy.
disc_cup_segmentation.coordinate_space: whole_image_resized_to_model_img_size at [512,512], plus actual mapping to source coordinates if an original-space overlay is supplied.
disc_cup_segmentation.cup_outside_disc_pixels: Nonnegative integer computed on the actual binary masks.
disc_cup_segmentation.containment_correction_applied: Explicit boolean; preserve uncorrected result and label any independently validated postprocessing.
disc_cup_segmentation.derived_measurements: Only measurements actually computed by backend with definitions and coordinate space; otherwise null. No inferred glaucoma diagnosis.

semantic_invariants: Completed outputs must also meet their corresponding completed_output_contracts, exact model registry and runtime provenance; generic response JSON validation alone is insufficient.
tool_unavailable means all stages are not_run, reason tool_unavailable, all outputs null, no fabricated execution times, scores or model-loaded claims.
quality_rejected requires a real completed quality result predicted Reject; downstream stages are not_run, output null, reason quality_rejected.
A stage skipped by policy remains not_run with output null and an actual route reason; skipped does not mean negative, normal, or DR grade0.
Per-stage errors are explicit and cannot be changed into low-risk/negative outputs; completed evidence can be retained with overall partial status.
Neither score thresholds nor probability calibration may be fitted using the test set or silently changed by the agent.
Raw softmax/sigmoid confidence is not a validated individual diagnosis probability.
Do not treat missing cross-source labels as negatives or merge training sources/tasks during integration.
Never fill per-image results with aggregate cohort evaluation statistics.

unavailable_response_example.message: 当前推理服务尚未连接，未完成图像筛查。
warnings: 未执行任何模型，不能据此判断图像正常、疾病阴性或DR等级。

example_semantics: The unavailable example contains no simulated model predictions. No successful inference example is provided until an actual backend call exists.
